note: Manual history events that have no linked ticket (purchases, installations, inspections). Repairs and service visits that came from a ticket are NOT stored here: the ticket is the single source of truth, and an equipment item's history is built from the tickets whose equipment_ids include it (see demo/ticket_details.json). An event may carry date, type, description, vendor and cost because there is no ticket to read them from. An event can also carry attachments: { photos: [], documents: [] }, each a durable reference (id, filename, mime, size). Seeded demo attachments also have a path to a static file; files added in the demo are stored in the browser (IndexedDB) under their id. Attachments are manager only.
